explanation: Where r>0, r′=2cos(4θ)/sqrt(1+sin(4θ)). Thus r²+(r′)²=1+sin(4θ)+4(1−sin(4θ))=5−3sin(4θ), giving option e. Splitting the curve at its isolated zeros justifies the arc-length formula there. Options a and b also give the same integral by periodic shifts over the full interval; e directly expresses the derived arc-length element.
